about.label: About
about.title: We are building the future of technology today
about.text: PolyTech Park is a technology park at Satbayev University, where science meets industry. For over 90 years the university has developed engineering sciences in close connection with the real economy, and the technopark brings research into practice — from work in its own laboratories to deploying solutions in the construction and industrial sectors.
about.pageText: PolyTechPark JSC is a subsidiary of Satbayev University, established to commercialize scientific developments and carry out R&D for industry.

history.title: Company history
body: PolyTechPark JSC was established as a platform for commercializing the scientific developments of Satbayev University and growing technology entrepreneurship in the construction and industrial sectors.
Over the years, the technopark has brought together researchers, engineers and industrial partners, delivering dozens of applied projects and building a modern laboratory base.

strategy.title: Development strategy
body: PolyTechPark's strategy is focused on building a full cycle — from a scientific idea to industrial implementation and bringing the product to market.
goals: Expanding the laboratory and engineering infrastructure
